home.metaDesc: Great hotels have stories that go beyond providing a bed for the night – they offer moments of discovery, unexpected adventures, encounters to be savoured.
home.text: DAY MODE BOOKINGS Hello Ciao Bonjour Konnichiwa Olá Namaste Aloha Ní hao Hola Guten Tag Hei Salaam Marhaba Hallo Great hotels have stories that go beyond providing a bed for the night – they offer moments of discovery, unexpected adventures, encounters to be savoured and retold. Once upon a time on James Street … A Day Begins It’s the breeze from my balcony that puts tropical lanais in my dreams, but no hammock ever had this thread count. Last night’s plan for a morning run has ebbed – the call of the pool is louder, more persuasive. Can I tell myself I did laps, if I pushed no harder than a glide and mostly gazed at the palms and sky? A platter of fruit poolside, and the day has begun with all the virtue it needs. Explore our rooms and suites Time to Wander There’s more to this place than the poolside vibe. My wandering takes in an amphitheatre, a grand room, cosy rooms for private dining and the library – a perfect place to linger, work or to just exhale. A place where stories can pause, or pivot. I’m not moving in a hurry and the next decision is easy: gymnasium before day spa. First the burn, then the reward. Explore our events spaces The Segue to SiestaHour, and Beyond Where were we? My massage set me down on a cloud, which became a cabana with a poolside cocktail. Still a dream? Maybe. Nobody pinch me. I don’t want to wake from this. accommodation.title: Luxury Accommodation James Street Brisbane
accommodation.metaDesc: Designed for people who know what they want – people who’ve seen average, but don’t plan to settle for it. Our rooms look good – but wait until you experience how they feel.
accommodation.text: BOOKINGS ROOMS & SUITES ESSENTIAL More personal oasis than hotel room – this room has such a sense of calm that you can almost hear it chanting ‘om’ under its breath. URBAN Just right, inside and out – love the neighbourhood as we do, and you’ll want to open your balcony door and let it into your room. CITY Take in the city views – close by when there’s city business to be taken care of, but a reminder that you’ve made a smarter choice. URBAN TERRACE Located on level two with indoor and outdoor living, just as you like it. Step out onto your private terrace balcony, with the sanctuary of your room at your back. POOLSIDE Take a seat on your generous balcony with the elegant pool and its surrounds before you. The best of resort-style living, planted in James Street. JUNIOR SUITE Separate bedroom and living area. Separate shower and luxury bath, designed for rejuvenation, bubbles and the contemplation of good fortune. A hotel experience worth toasting. DELUXE SUITE Step inside from your terrace-style balcony, resist the lure of the deluxe bath and discover this is the kind of suite they write songs about. ADA SUITE Your sky residence. Where to make the most of your private rooftop terrace, we had a CBD constructed nearby so there’s always a light show. CALILE SUITE The address that goes ‘The Calile, The Calile, 48 James Street’ is neither echo nor coincidence. It’s definitive – it’s our signature, signed with a flourish.
